decisions: Minutes from the August 16, 2025 board meeting approved as amended (Q2 revenue figure corrected to $4.3M).
Approved reallocation of $150,000 from contingency reserve to fund the digital invoicing system rollout, with a completion target of November 30, 2025.

Approved corrective action plan for Polestar Industries account, including appointment of a dedicated account liaison by September 27, 2025 and revised internal deadline protocols; Margaret Holvan to lead in-person meeting with Polestar Industries leadership by October 10, 2025.

Approved hiring of two senior compliance analysts and one senior client services manager by October 31, 2025, and extension of three contractor agreements through December 31, 2025; recruitment to begin by September 24, 2025.
Approved technology infrastructure upgrade at a budget not to exceed $230,000, with phase one migration by November 15, 2025 and full implementation by December 20, 2025.

Scheduled formal 2026 strategic planning session for the week of December 8, 2025; competitive landscape analysis to be delivered by November 21, 2025; board members to submit written position statements by November 28, 2025.
